record.title: Test exact-stock guest labeling through the next startup boundary
record.intent: Determine whether a scoped platform seinfo assignment permits stock Sparrow process initialization.
requirements: Preserve stock APK, firmware evidence, original guest image, and prior experiments.
Modify only the admitted exact-stock package in disposable guest state; retain original signature checks elsewhere.
Keep host policy and physical devices untouched; no global policy disabling or hardware behavioral model.
Keep stable instrumentation teardown and snapshot executable helpers before each run.
acceptance: Inspect the actual framework field and assignment ordering and document the guest-domain assumption.
Bind labeling to the exact APK digest, package, signer, and system shared UID; exercise negative controls.
Repeat clean-state attempts and capture process label, lifecycle or next failure, native logs and screenshots.
Distinguish harness faults from application outcomes and preserve all input hashes.
A reproduced negative outcome closes this question without iterative substitutions to force success.
